mostWorthwhile.text: Following metal droplets as gravity draws them deeper made Earth's differentiation easy to picture, while acknowledging several possible pathways.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final crust-forming combination felt less informative than the cooling step before it: combining crystals with hot melt did not make the gathering mechanism especially clear.

surprise.text: The first crust formed as fragile, temporary patches rather than a permanent solid shell.

arbitrary.text: Combining the crystals with hot melt to gather crustal rafts felt somewhat arbitrary; I followed the only offered combination without understanding exactly how it would work.
